claims.claim: SoundHound Q2 2026 revenue reached a record $61.9M, up 45% year over year, and management raised its full-year outlook.
The company identifies OASYS as a driver of enterprise AI adoption, extending the business beyond its earlier automotive/voice footprint.
Q1 core automotive and IoT AI revenue growth excluding acquisitions was reported at 88%, evidence that at least part of growth was organic rather than solely acquired.

factors.name: enterprise agentic AI expansion
factors.basis: OASYS and enterprise channel expansion create a broader demand surface.

factors.name: organic core growth
factors.basis: Reported Q1 growth excluding acquisitions reduces, but does not eliminate, concern that expansion is acquisition-only.

risks.risk: Rapid expansion across products and acquisitions can increase integration and execution complexity.

unknowns.unknown: Durability and margin profile of OASYS-led enterprise growth across a full renewal cycle remain unproven.

claims.claim: Q2 GAAP gross margin improved to 45.1% from 39.0% a year earlier and GAAP operating loss narrowed to $43.3M from $78.1M.
Non-GAAP adjusted EBITDA remained negative at $9.6M in Q2 despite improving from negative $14.3M a year earlier.

factors.name: top-line execution
factors.basis: 45% Q2 revenue growth and raised outlook show strong demand conversion.

factors.name: profitability conversion
factors.basis: Margins and losses improved, but adjusted EBITDA and GAAP operating income remain negative.

risks.risk: Growth must continue converting into sustainable cash economics; current profitability remains incomplete.

contradictions.claim: Record growth coexists with continuing operating losses.
contradictions.resolution: The operating trend is improving but the evidence does not support representing the business as sustainably profitable yet.

unknowns.unknown: Scout does not assert a security-level valuation or entry recommendation.
